$comment: Canonical registry for MindAttic.Deploy. Three arrays: `projects` is README-driven landing pages at mindattic.com/<slug>.htm (rendered via template/index.template.htm); `sites` is verbatim root-site FTP uploads (mindattic.com root, mindatticcares.com, ryandebraal.com); `apps` is Blazor / GitHub-Actions-driven deploys (StreetSamurai today; IdiotProof/TaxRateCollector/ThinkTank/Tutor stubbed pending infra). Build/Deploy = node src/build.js / src/deploy.js. componentsVersion pins the jsDelivr tag for MindAttic.UIUX (Components and Themes both come from this ref); use 'main' for tip-of-tree, or 'v1.0.0' style tags for immutable cache hits in production. Each project picks a theme via the 'theme' field; valid values match folder names under MindAttic.UIUX/Themes/ (currently: Cyberspace, Hardware).

apps.disabledNote: Workflow targets `idiotproof-web` App Service. Needs Azure infrastructure + AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret in mindattic/IdiotProof. Set `disabled: false` once those exist.
Workflow targets `taxratecollector` App Service. Needs Azure infrastructure + AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret in mindattic/TaxRateCollector. Set `disabled: false` once those exist.
No workflow yet. Add .github/workflows/azure-deploy.yml (mirror StreetSamurai's pattern), provision an Azure App Service, add AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret, then set `disabled: false`.
